title: Face Words
label: ch:ml-face-words
canDo: I can name my eye, ear, nose and mouth in Malayalam, and say which of the four the family agrees on almost completely and which one Kannada alone breaks from.

payoff.summary: Name kannu, chevi, mookku and vaay, run the near-total four-way match on eye against chevi's three-against-one split on ear, and recall that Chapter 33 already named vaay once only to rule it out of vaayikkuka.
